origin: Supplementary direct Ghidra headless -noanalysis, using the REA seed script. Not REA MCP Evidence.

observations.observed: Calls IsWindowVisible on this+0x20 and forwards normalized 0/1 through virtual slot +0 of the update object. Tail-call arguments are visible in assembly although omitted in decompiler output.
observations.unknown: Active registration class, window identity and effective global Open availability.

observations.observed: Forwards false through update slot +0 when 0x687ae0 is nonzero, when nested object type callback +0x304 returns 5 and capability +0x110(0x20) is false, or when final 0x5f5370 returns zero. The remaining path sends no explicit true.
observations.unknown: Meaning of global predicate, type code and capability mask; surrounding update chain and class context.

observations.observed: Forwards true when two global-object callbacks +0x284 and +0x564 succeed; otherwise forwards result of 0x859920 with command ID 0x509 (1289).
observations.unknown: Underlying page-range logic and meaning of both global callbacks.

observations.observed: When a view is returned by 0x8595e0, obtains zoom through 0x880450 and virtual +0x58; sends false at finite zoom >=64.0. Other paths make no update call in this body.
observations.unknown: Who enables this control on other paths; exact view class and all non-finite/plugin cases.

observations.observed: Uses the same view/zoom callbacks and sends false at finite zoom <=0.01. Other paths make no update call in this body.
observations.unknown: Surrounding enable/default policy and actual UI range in each context.

observations.label_context: Print All Tabs candidate, resource 645 / ID 1275
observations.observed: Enumerates objects through virtual count +0x1cc/item +0x1d0, counts nonnull objects accepted by 0x48f10ef with descriptor 0x6552ed4, and sends true only when the qualifying count is greater than one.
observations.unknown: Descriptor/type meaning; qualifying count must not be equated to every visible tab.

observations.observed: Reads BM_GETCHECK (0xf0) from HWND at this+0x780 and writes this+0x1d58. It does not write page-text field +0x1d60 in this body.
observations.unknown: Why the same structural handler is associated with both labels; do not claim that it implements both independent toggles. Previous DDX bindings remain separate evidence.

limitations: Instruction-address agreement does not prove class ownership, full signatures, availability or runtime behavior.

static_update_slot_interpretation: Update slot +0 and notification 0xffffffff are consistent with MFC-style command enable updates; active registration class/runtime not established.
limitations: Identical control IDs in different dialogs/classes do not prove identical behavior.
Message-map bytes and examined function bodies do not identify the active runtime class.
Template enabled/checked/focus declarations may be changed by code or feature availability.
Connections and control existence do not prove that a dialog is reachable in Reader.
This static inventory does not complete the stage-11 runtime interaction criterion.
